answers.why: All Naphtali is territory shown to Moses as part of the land.
Manasseh shares the reference to tribal land shown to Moses.
A prophet arising in Israel means arising among the nation.
All Israel is the community that witnessed Moses' mighty deeds.
Joshua addresses half the tribe of Manasseh about their allotted land.
All Israel will recognize Joshua's authority, expressed with the plural 'they may know.'
All Israel crosses the Jordan and is identified as the whole nation.
Half the tribe of Manasseh crosses armed for battle.
All Israel witnesses Joshua's elevation and fears him as they feared Moses.
Israel is the people whose crossing of the Jordan their children will commemorate.
Rahab's family is placed outside the camp of the Israelite community.
Rahab dwells among Israel after Joshua saves her at Jericho.
